thread:
olivia-cs: FYI Lumen integration hit a weird auth+rate pattern during onboarding. They see intermittent 401 then a flurry of 429s when their CI spins up ~40 parallel preflight requests. They asked for quick mitigation
kevin-se: do we have their SDK call pattern? parallel preflights usually cause token stampede or proxy stripping headers
olivia-cs: pasted from customer (they're on a custom proxy):
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 123

{"input":"hello"}
```
Response: 401 (sometimes) then cluster of 429s for next 30s
tarun-sre: if auth returns 401 then client retries without splay, can cause preflight fanout. Any evidence their ephemeral token rotation is mis-timed?
olivia-cs: they rotate every 60s (short-lived) and their CI launches tasks in lockstep. Also they use a proxy that re-signs or forwards requests — suspected header rewrite
devon-soleng: tagging @edge-proxy-bot — any logs of header rewrite on their edge?
edge-proxy-bot: noticed 112 requests from lumen.dev network between 1766667720-1766667780 with Authorization present in 87% of requests. 13% had Authorization header removed due to OPTIONS->POST reuse bug on proxy v1.4.2
kevin-se: that matches — missing auth leads to 401, client retries, hits rate limiter -> 429. Two prongs: (1) advise customer to increase token TTL or randomize refresh timing; (2) fix proxy to preserve Authorization on proxied requests
olivia-cs: Customer asked for a short-term workaround they can do today — they can't upgrade proxy immediately
tarun-sre: short-term: add jitter to token refresh + exponential backoff on 401, reduce parallelism on initial warmup (stagger workers). Also enable client to reuse connection pool (keep-alive) to avoid new preflight connections that some proxies mishandle
devon-soleng: suggested code snippet for JS SDK:```js
// simple jittered refresh
const jitter = (ms)=> ms * (0.5 + Math.random()*0.5);
await sleep(jitter(1500));
// stagger starts
await sleep(Math.floor(Math.random()*5000));
```
olivia-cs: shared that with Lumen. They replied they can stagger and add jitter; still want us to open an ops ticket for proxy vendor since their infra team prefers vendor patch
olivia-cs: Created support ticket #CS-3627 and scheduled touchpoint with Lumen infra tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Will include proxy logs and our suggestions
kevin-se: also push a temporary server-side fallback: if model route returns 401 for a known customer and subsequent requests spike, consider short-circuiting to a soft-queue (delay+retry) instead of hard 429. That buys time for client fixes
tarun-sre: agreed. I'll add a short-lived rate-limit smoothing rule for the Lumen org id (10s window) and roll back after the call
devon-soleng: I'll update onboarding docs with a best-practice checklist: token TTL >= 120s for CI, jitter refresh, avoid synchronized start, and proxy compatibility note
olivia-cs: perfect. Customer said this sequence sounds workable. Will log follow-up outcomes in the ticket. Thanks team :thumbsup:
kevin-se: +1. Can we add a quick monitoring alert for auth-401->429 spikes for new orgs onboarding? That will catch next ones early
tarun-sre: will add a dashboard card and alert threshold (>=15% 401->429 rate within 1m for orgs < 7 days old)
olivia-cs: closing loop here. Next update after the 10:00 call.
